verdict.rationale: ChatGPT ships extensive built-in agentic delegation: Work/Codex modes that carry tasks through to completion, background/scheduled tasks with event triggers, browser and computer-use tools, MCP/plugin integrations, and voice-driven task delegation — all documented as native features rather than third-party add-ons. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the newer agentic features (Work, Goal mode, event-triggered tasks) beyond vendor docs, since community evidence mostly covers older chat/search capabilities.
